sourceChecks.sourceText: Shallum was the son of Kore, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah, and his brothers, of his father’s house, the Korahites, were over the work of the service, keepers of the thresholds of the tent. Their fathers had been over the LORD’s camp, keepers of the entry.
sourceChecks.previousContext: who previously served in the king’s gate eastward. They were the gatekeepers for the camp of the children of Levi.
sourceChecks.nextContext: Phinehas the son of Eleazar was ruler over them in time past, and the LORD was with him.

sourceChecks.sourceText: For the divisions of the doorkeepers: of the Korahites, Meshelemiah the son of Kore, of the sons of Asaph.
sourceChecks.nextContext: Meshelemiah had sons: Zechariah the firstborn, Jediael the second, Zebadiah the third, Jathniel the fourth,
